requirements.evidence: Queues component implements the full contract (properties name/creating/viewingQueueId/confirmingToggle/editingQueueId/renameName/accessQueueId/managingAccess and all 15 methods, app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:28-198); slug derived via Str::slug on create and rename (Queues.php:81,128); toggle uses a Bulma confirmation modal, no wire:confirm (queues.blade.php:105-126); render passes accessQueue/accessGrants scoped and empty for foreign ids (Queues.php:200-216). Serve: selectedQueueId default to first callable queue (Serve.php:54), waiting list ordered priority desc/issued_at/id, mode-filtered, limit 30 and empty when Gate denies 'call' (Serve.php:438-460), callNext handles null selection, Inactive/NoWaiting exceptions, lets AuthorizationException through, rate-limits successful calls (Serve.php:57-96). Members tabs with role="tablist" and whitelist in setActiveTab (Members.php:68-73, members.blade.php:6-21). Routes and navbar links added (routes/web.php:59-60, default-page.blade.php:49-56). All contract lang keys present in both locales. Small gaps: waiting list issue time shown as H:i only and labels serve_code/serve_issued/serve_channel defined but unused; callableQueues relies on an unshown membershipFor() helper.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket and authorization through policies ($this->authorize('update'|'manageAccess'|'create', ...)). But the user-input properties name, renameName and mode carry no #[Validate] attribute (Queues.php:29,47; Serve.php:42) — mode is validated with an inline rule array (Serve.php:70), name/renameName rely only on the domain action — contrary to the project's '#[Validate] + $this->validate()' pattern and Livewire policy rule 1. No CHANGELOG.md/docs update in the diff although the conventions require keeping docs in sync. Repeated row/modal markup is inlined instead of using Blade components; otherwise matches the members page style.

security.evidence: Every public action that touches data resolves ids scoped to the entity (`$this->entity->queues()->findOrFail(...)`, `$this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail($membershipId)`) and authorizes (Queues.php:94-97,111-114,126-128,143-146,156-159,168-171,224-229); entity and lastCalledTicketId are #[Locked]; render uses find() scoped so tampered accessQueueId/viewingQueueId disclose nothing; all output via {{ }}; mode validated against the CallMode enum before CallMode::from; rate limit per user+entity. Minor gap: name/renameName are not validated at component level (length etc.) and depend entirely on the domain actions.

tests.evidence: QueuesPageTest covers employee 403 (route+component), list without per-row actions, create/duplicate slug, rename re-derivation and collision, toggle confirmation, nested reset, grant/revoke, foreign-id not-found for each id-taking method and a tampered accessQueueId (tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php). ServePanelTest covers non-member 403, default selection, employee grant filtering and forbidden callNext, call order/mode, success, no selection, inactive, foreign queue, locked lastCalledTicketId and rate limiting. Gaps: the 'audit trail' test never asserts an audit log entry; no pt_BR render test for queues/serve; no direct test of unauthorized action calls on Queues beyond mount. Existing invite/members tests were adapted to the tabs (moved assertions into setActiveTab('invites')) rather than weakened.

simplicity.evidence: Direct component code reusing the domain actions. Some duplication: the 'permissions contains call' QueueAccess filter appears in both Queues::accessGrants (Queues.php:240-245) and Serve::callableQueues (Serve.php:423-427), and the manager-role check is reimplemented in Serve.php:419 and queues.blade.php:139 instead of relying on QueuePolicy; `whereRaw('1 = 0')` (Serve.php:416) is an awkward way to return an empty collection.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods, PHPDoc on untrusted properties, consistent with Members sibling style. Minor: @php block with fully qualified \App\Models\UserRole in the view (queues.blade.php:138-141), several unused lang keys (serve_code, serve_issued, serve_channel), heavy inline styles.

scope.evidence: All changes serve the task: two components + views, routes, navbar, lang keys, members tabs and tests; the extra key serve_rate_limited supports the required rate limit. No unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: Public user-input properties name, renameName and mode have no #[Validate] attribute, deviating from the project's Livewire validation pattern and security policy rule 1 (mode uses an inline rules array, names rely solely on the domain action).
New routes and pages are not recorded in CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] or the docs, which the conventions require in the same change.
The test named 'grants and revokes call access with an audit trail' never asserts that an audit log entry was written.

callableQueues re-implements the call-permission logic (manager roles + QueueAccess permission filter) that QueuePolicy::call already owns and that is duplicated in Queues::accessGrants, risking drift.
Lang keys serve_code, serve_issued and serve_channel are added but unused; the ticket row shows unlabeled time and channel.
Role logic in a @php block of the view with fully qualified class names; better computed in the component.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues management page, the Serve panel, members tabs, navbar links, routes and bilingual lang keys, with scoped id resolution, server-side authorization on every action and thorough feature tests including tamper and foreign-id cases. It meets essentially the whole contract; deductions are for missing #[Validate] on user-input properties, no CHANGELOG/docs update, some duplicated permission logic and an audit-log test that does not assert the log. Approvable after small fixes.
